reason: Based on the repository name, README, and package metadata, the plugin is primarily an external-service integration that helps agents archive and read WeChat Official Account articles by calling a 2100laike endpoint, with a dedicated tool interface returning markdown content and related article metadata.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH Agent 提供 wx_archive 工具，可将微信公众号文章链接提交到 2100laike 存档服务并返回可读正文与文章元信息。
summaries.en: This plugin provides a wx_archive tool for DSH agents to send WeChat Official Account article links to the 2100laike archive service and get back readable content with article metadata.

capabilities: Calls a configurable external HTTP API for WeChat article archiving and retrieval
Accepts article URL input and optional refresh flag to trigger re-archiving
Returns structured article data including markdown content and metadata fields

reasons.code: README describes the plugin purpose as archiving and reading WeChat Official Account articles, with mp.weixin.qq.com handling via wx_archive.
README defines config with apiBaseUrl and optional token, indicating outbound network dependency and external service authentication.
Package metadata identifies it as a DeepSeek Harness tool plugin with a bundled cordis patch and main entry lib/index.js, confirming integration-style plugin behavior.
